ais.name: വല്യസ്താദ്
ais.description: That very big, bigger and biggest usthaad
dialogues: Thaaavanoo alal birri vathaqwa valaa thaavanoo alal ithmi wal udwan
onnu randu kaaryangal oormappeduthaanaan ezhunnettu ninnath
SMSilekk pooya ellarudeyum list kittiyittund
Class Cleaning cheythittundo class leader?
Naattilekk pokumbol ividenn cheythirunna kaaryangal marakkaathe cheyyuka

inn ethraa aalukal raavile eneettitt bismika rabbi cholliyittund onn kayy pokkoo
